summary_en: Yushin initiated a share buyback program with an upper limit of 2,000,000 shares (6.39% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) and 1.0 billion yen in acquisition cost, to be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 13, 2026 and May 12, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, the board of directors of Yushin Company resolved to acquire treasury shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied with substitutions by Article 165, Paragraph 3, based on the company's articles of incorporation. The buyback program is designed to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns.

The company will acquire up to 2,000,000 shares of its common stock, representing 6.4% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, with a maximum expenditure of 1.0 billion yen. Shares will be acquired through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from November 13, 2026 through May 12, 2027. As of October 31, 2026, the company had 31,310,338 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock) and held 4,327,728 shares as treasury stock.
